image_description: A close-up view of an industrial sawmill mechanism. The foreground features a wooden conveyor track with light-colored planks moving along it. Behind the track, there are large, rusty metal wheels and gears, part of the machinery driving the system. The background is cluttered with mechanical components, wood debris, and hints of yellow painted metal structures. The scene is gritty, with visible sawdust and wear on the equipment.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The mechanical connections in the background are nonsensical. Axles appear to float without proper bearing supports, and gears seem to merge into each other or the background without clear physical separation or logical drivetrain connectivity.

The wood grain on the conveyor planks is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine fibrous detail expected from cut lumber. The edges of the planks also show slight softness/bleeding into the air.
The large wheel on the right has an inconsistent elliptical shape that doesn't quite match the perspective of the axle it is supposedly mounted on, suggesting a slight geometric warping.
